chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Indeed, my intercession is only for the people of major sins from my nation.

key_terms.أَهْلِ: the people of; those characterized by or belonging to a category
key_terms.أُمَّتِي: my nation; the community of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْكَبَائِرِ: the major sins; grave acts for which severe punishment is threatened
key_terms.شَفَاعَتِي: my intercession; the Prophet’s granted mediation by Allah for members of his Ummah

ai.seo_question: Who is the Prophet's intercession for according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the shafa'ah of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله is for members of his Ummah who committed major sins. It highlights the theological reality of intercession and its connection to divine mercy, especially in relation to grave sin and the Hereafter.
